tagline: Musabaqat: team quiz games that run in the browser
brief: The umbrella for a family of Arabic team quiz games (سوق المعرفة, ورقة الحظ, حصون المعرفة), played offline in the browser and shared as a GitHub repo and Pages site. The logo leads the link-preview card.
criteria: Holds the three games together without copying one; avoids quiz clichés (question marks, bulbs, trophies, buzzers); reads in a 400 px link preview and at 16 px.

concepts.name: Three Dots
concepts.idea: Three calligraphy dots, as written over ث, one per game in that game's colour.
rationale: An Arabic sign without using a letter; echoes the name's own dots (ق ت)
One dot per game: green souq, yellow cards, blue fortress
Equal 18-unit gaps; still three dots at 16 px
Grows with the family: a new game recolours or adds a dot in the pattern

recommendation: Three Dots: the simplest, most Arabic and most scalable of the three directions.
